Several new designs are in process, including: Alien Uprising, Mythos Tales, Master Villains Super Spies and Schemes of Mass Destruction, Swashbucklers Soldiers and Scoundrels, Chronos Wars, Freedom Five and Mayhem in Megalopolis. Also new expansions for Elder Sign and Defenders of the Realm are in development.

What is Freedom Five and Mayhem in Megalopolis? Is that something we have already seen or something to come?
